About.title: Learn online consistently and see your progress
About.description: EduPlatform brings together everything you need to learn on your own: choosing a course, paying, studying and tracking progress.
About.storyTitle: It started with one question: why do people quit online courses?
About.storyParagraph1: Buying a course is easy, finishing it is hard. Long videos, no idea how far you have come, ticking "done" without actually watching. EduPlatform was built to solve exactly those problems.
About.storyParagraph2: Lessons are split into chapters, progress is based on real watch time, and you can start learning as soon as you pay. Students always know where they are, and instructors see how their courses are received.

access.question: How long can I access a course after buying it?
access.answer: Forever. Enrolled courses always stay in "My courses" and you can come back to them anytime.

payment.question: Which payment methods are available?
payment.answer: Bank transfer via QR code (the system detects the payment and unlocks the course within minutes) or PayPal for learners abroad.

transferPending.question: I transferred the money but the course is still locked?
transferPending.answer: Make sure the transfer reference contains the order code. The checkout page re-checks every few seconds, and pending orders are always available from the cart icon at the top of the page.

completion.question: When does a lesson count as completed?
completion.answer: When you have watched at least 90% of the video. Skipping ahead does not count, so your completion rate always reflects real learning.

becomeInstructor.question: How do I become an instructor?
becomeInstructor.answer: Instructor accounts are granted by an administrator. You can then create a course, add chapters, lessons and videos, and submit it for review before it is published.
